decisions.quote: Compared to our prior study,1 dosing with sweetener generated significant, but much smaller changes in the composition of the gut microbiota (Figure 4). Since dosing with sweetener did not result in the same microbiota across studies, our findings are unable to support or refute our prior observation that changes in the gut microbiota can increase bone tissue strength above what is seen in mice with an unaltered gut microbiota.
decisions.reason: Although sweetener dosing did not replicate the microbiota shift or bone tissue strength increase, the authors explicitly state the overall substantive verdict that because the treatment failed to produce the same microbiota across studies, their findings are unable to support or refute the original observation.
